summary: Retested 3 bug fixes (Palla di Fuoco backfill, º/° ordinal parser, list refresh via useFocusEffect) + new PickerField dropdown feature. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Palla di Fuoco now appears in Grimorio search with '3° LIV. · INVOCAZIONE' (backfill worked on U+00BA); Create FAB opens /spell/new with 5 PickerFields (livello, tempo_di_lancio, gittata, componenti, durata) + plain TextInputs for nome and descrizione; bottom-sheet modal has search filter (4 results for 'trucchetto') and 'Altro...' free-text mode that accepts the 'º' character; on Save navigates to /spell/{id}, and returning to Grimorio the new spell appears immediately with correctly parsed '3° LIV. · INVOCAZIONE' (useFocusEffect works). All 3 bugs are FIXED and the dropdown feature is fully functional.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings persist: 'shadow*' props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking, carried over from iteration 1. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/spells.tsx:640-644 (createFab shadow* props).

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow across styles (e.g. createFab in spells.tsx:640-644) and any 'pointerEvents' JSX props with style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: parse_livello regex now correctly matches both '°' (U+00B0) and 'º' (U+00BA): re.compile(r'(\d+)\s*[°º]\s*livello', re.IGNORECASE) — validated by pytest.
Startup backfill re-parses spells with livello_num=-1 OR scuola=='' — Palla di Fuoco successfully upgraded to livello_num=3, scuola=Invocazione, classi=['mago','stregone'].
GET /api/spells/suggestions correctly returns 6 keys with scuole hardcoded to the 8 D&D schools and other lists sorted by frequency (aggregate $group/$sort). No _id leakage.
useFocusEffect in app/(tabs)/spells.tsx correctly refetches on tab focus after create/edit — BUG 3 fixed.
PickerField modal implementation is clean: testable via data-testid=`{testID}-search`, `{testID}-option-{value}`, `{testID}-other`, `{testID}-custom-input`, `{testID}-custom-apply`.
Note: app.on_event startup/shutdown is deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+; consider lifespan handlers (non-blocking, carried from iteration 1).

rca_of_issue: BUG 1 (Palla di Fuoco missing from Grimorio): user typed '3º livello' with U+00BA (masculine ordinal indicator, iOS Italian keyboard long-press on 3), but parser regex only matched U+00B0 (°). Result: livello_num=-1, scuola=''. Fix — regex character class [°º] now matches both AND startup backfill re-parses existing records with livello_num=-1 or scuola=''. Verified: Palla di Fuoco now returns livello_num=3, scuola='Invocazione', classi=['mago','stregone']. BUG 3 (list not refreshing): screens.tsx now wraps loadSpells in useFocusEffect (verified by creating a spell → nav to detail → back to /spells → new row appears).
